description: Use this when the user asks which Polymarket or prediction-market odds moved the most, what is rising or falling, or what changed today — for example "biggest movers on Polymarket", "which markets moved the most in the last 24 hours", "what odds are dropping in crypto", or "biggest swings in politics today". Returns up to 20 open Polymarket.com markets ranked by their 24-hour change in market-implied probability (points), with the outcome that moved, its probability and 24-hour volume; at most two per event. Optional filters: direction and category. Covers the 300 most-traded markets with at least $10K traded in 24 hours; markets at 1% or below or 99% or above are left out as effectively decided. Excludes individual sports and esports games (single matches and their side markets, live or upcoming) unless the category is sports or esports; futures such as a season or championship winner stay in. Mature topics are left out, and so are "Up or Down" and tweet-count markets without a category. Read-only crowd forecasts, not advice. Do not use this to choose a market or trader for the user to put money in. Do not call this when the user asks which market to buy or how to make a profit.

category.description: Limit to one Polymarket category, e.g. 'politics', 'crypto', 'sports', 'economy'. Omit for all categories

direction.description: Which moves to include: 'up' (probability rose), 'down' (probability fell) or 'both' (default)

name: get_market_movers

outcome_label.description: The outcome whose probability moved (usually 'Yes' or the candidate/option name)

title: Get biggest market moves
